## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what this change does.

## Validation

List relevant checks and results. For hardware work, include model, Android version, controlled targets, misses/false positives and checks not run. For docs, check links and rendered assets.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Claims match what the app measures; no unsupported camera verdict or accuracy promise.
- [ ] Private evidence, identifiers, credentials and signing keys are excluded.
- [ ] Foreground cleanup, permission handling and privacy behavior are preserved when applicable.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and unrun checks are stated.
